dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I want to live a greener life. Where should I start?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈlɪv ə ˈɡriːnər ˈlaɪf. ˈwɛr ʃʊd aɪ ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's start with plastic. We should use less plastic and buy fewer bottles of water.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈstɑːrt wɪð ˈplæstɪk. wiː ʃʊd ˈjuːz ˈlɛs ˈplæstɪk ənd ˈbaɪ ˈfjuːər ˈbɑːtəlz əv ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But I drink a huge amount of water every day!
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈdrɪŋk ə ˈhjuːdʒ əˈmaʊnt əv ˈwɔːtər ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then get a water bottle and fill it at home.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈɡɛt ə ˈwɔːtər ˌbɑːtəl ənd ˈfɪl ɪt ət ˈhoʊm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea. What other things can we do?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈwʌt ˈʌðər ˈθɪŋz kən wiː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We should use less electricity. Let's use the fan more and the air conditioning less.
dialogue.reading: wiː ʃʊd ˈjuːz ˈlɛs ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti. ˈlɛts ˈjuːz ðə ˈfæn ˈmɔːr ənd ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ ˈlɛs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And I'll take fewer taxis. I can take the train.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd aɪl ˈteɪk ˈfjuːər ˈtæksiz. aɪ kən ˈteɪk ðə ˈtreɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Fewer cars on the road means less pollution.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ˈfjuːər ˈkɑːrz ɑːn ðə ˈroʊd ˈmiːnz ˈlɛs pəˈluːʃən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But do small things like this really help?
dialogue.reading: bʌt duː ˈsmɔːl ˈθɪŋz laɪk ˈðɪs ˈriːli ˈhɛlp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Water, oil and forests are natural resources. If we use them too fast, we'll run out of them.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˈwɔːtər, ˈɔɪl ənd ˈfɔːrɪsts ər ˈnætʃərəl ˈriːsɔːrsɪz. ɪf wiː ˈjuːz ðɛm ˈtuː ˈfæst, wiːl ˈrʌn ˈaʊt əv ðɛm.
